_note: Our own writing. Arc shapes: a situation over a few missions at one hub, escalating to a reveal and a confrontation (patterns: docs/research/lancer_campaigns.md section 5). The arc's next hook is always on the job board; finishing it (win or lose: every mission advances the story, and pilots level up either way, Core p.40) moves the arc on. 'on_win' / 'on_loss' are story effects; stage text uses {a}/{b} (the conflict's sides), {rival} (a recurring enemy squad name) and the hook placeholders.
